productForm.createSubtitle: Start with the basics. You add options, stock and photos on the next screen.
productForm.typeHint: The type can't be changed once the product is created.
productForm.typePhoneBody: Storage, RAM and colour options, with full specifications.
productForm.typeAccessoryBody: Cases, chargers, audio… shown on the phones they fit.
productForm.name: Product name
productForm.nameHint: As customers see it in each store language.
productForm.slugHint: Made from the English name. Lowercase English letters, numbers and dashes.
productForm.slugEditHint: Changing the link breaks links customers have already shared.
productForm.noCategories: There is no category for this type yet.
productForm.descriptionHint: Shown on the product page. Line breaks are kept.
productForm.featuredHint: Featured products appear on the home page and first in listings.
productForm.stepOptionsBody: Storage, colour, price and units for each option.
productForm.stepPhotosBody: Up to 12 photos; the first one is the cover.
productForm.stepPublishBody: It can go live once it has an option on sale.
productForm.detailsDescription: Name, page link, brand, category and description.

fieldErrors.slug: Use lowercase English letters, numbers and single dashes.

productEditor.publishedBody: Customers can find and order this product.
productEditor.draftBody: Only staff can see this product.
productEditor.publishBlocked: Add an option on sale before publishing.

variants.title: Options & stock
variants.description: Each option is one thing a customer can buy, with its own price and units.
variants.emptyBodyPhone: Add the first one, e.g. 128 GB · Black. The product can be published once an option is on sale.
variants.emptyBodyAccessory: Add one per colour, or a single option if it comes in one version.
variants.hideLastTitle: Hide the last option on sale?
variants.hideLastBody: The product will be unpublished until an option is on sale again.
variants.dialogDescription: Customers choose an option on the product page. Each has its own price and stock.
variants.colorHint: Leave it empty if this option has no colour.
variants.swatchHint: The dot customers tap to pick this colour.
variants.compareAtHint: The original price, shown struck through while this option is on sale.
variants.skuHint: Your stock code, unique across the store. Letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
variants.activeHint: Hidden options stay on past orders but can't be bought.
variants.initialStockHint: Adjust it later as deliveries arrive.

fieldErrors.sku: Use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores, with no spaces.
fieldErrors.skuDuplicate: Another option of this product already uses this SKU.
fieldErrors.colorBoth: Enter the colour in both languages (up to 50 characters), or leave the colour empty.
fieldErrors.price: Enter a price above zero, e.g. 499 or 499.500.
fieldErrors.compareAt: The was price must be higher than the price.
fieldErrors.stock: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100,000.
fieldErrors.duplicate: Another option already has this storage, RAM and colour. Customers couldn't tell them apart.

stockDialog.title: Adjust stock
stockDialog.quantityHint: Received: a delivery arrived. Removed: a count came up short, or units were damaged.
stockDialog.invalid: Enter a whole number above zero.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: The first photo is the cover in listings and on shared links. Drag photos to reorder them.
photos.dropTitle: Drop photos here, or click to browse
photos.dropHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB each. Room for {remaining} more.
photos.empty: Products with clear photos on a plain background sell best.
photos.full: This product has the maximum of 12 photos. Remove one to add another.
photos.wrongType: not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
photos.noRoom: no room left (12 photos at most).
photos.reorderFailed: The new order couldn't be saved. Try again.
photos.removeBody: It disappears from the store right away.

specs.title: Specifications
specs.description: Shown as a table on the product page, in this order.
specs.emptyBody: Add the details customers compare: display, chip, camera, battery.
specs.label: Label
specs.incomplete: Fill in the label and value in both languages, or remove the row.

brands.title: Brands
brands.subtitle: The store's brand filters list them in this order. Hidden brands leave the filters; their products stay on sale.
brands.emptyBody: Add the makers you sell, like Apple or Samsung, before adding their products.
brands.name: Name
brands.nameHint: Brand names are the same in both languages.
brands.slugHint: Made from the name. Lowercase English letters, numbers and dashes.
brands.visibleHint: Hidden brands leave the store's brand filters. Their products stay on sale.

fieldErrors.slug: Use lowercase English letters, numbers and single dashes.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Each product type has its own categories, shown in this order on the home page and in filters. Hidden categories leave both; their products stay on sale.
categories.name: Name
categories.slugHint: Made from the English name. Lowercase English letters, numbers and dashes.
categories.visibleHint: Hidden categories leave the home page and the store's filters. Their products stay on sale.
categories.deleteBody: No product uses this category, so nothing else changes. This can't be undone.

fieldErrors.slug: Use lowercase English letters, numbers and single dashes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How the store introduces itself, how customers reach you, and what delivery costs.
settings.storeDescription: The name and logo customers see.
settings.storeNameHint: Shown in the header when there's no logo, in page titles and in the footer.
settings.logoHint: PNG or WebP with a transparent background, up to 5 MB. It's shown 32 px tall in the header; check the dark banner preview too, a dark logo can disappear there.
settings.logoNone: No logo: the header shows the store name.
settings.contactDescription: Shown in the store's footer so customers can reach you.
settings.supportPhoneHint: Type it as you'd dial it; it's saved in international form.
settings.whatsAppHint: Customers can message you from the store.
settings.deliveryDescription: What customers pay for delivery at checkout.
settings.deliveryFeeHint: Charged once per order. 0 makes every order free.
settings.freeDeliveryHint: Orders at or above this amount ship free. The cart tells customers how much more they need.
settings.guestCheckoutHint: Customers order with just a name, phone and address, without an account.
settings.guestCheckoutOff: Only signed-in customers could order, and the store has no customer sign-in pages yet, so turning this off stops all new orders.
settings.regionDescription: The currency prices are shown in, and how phone numbers are read.
settings.countryCodeHint: Numbers typed without one, like 079 123 4567, get this code. Jordan is 962, Palestine 970.
settings.currencyChanged: Prices aren't converted: every price keeps its number and shows in {to} instead of {from}. Past orders keep their own currency.
settings.previewDelivery: Delivery, as the store words it

fieldErrors.email: Enter an email address like help@example.com.
fieldErrors.money: Enter an amount of 0 or more, e.g. 3 or 2.500.
